findings.explanation: HOL4 introduces `instance` by new_specification. The only saved theorem, instance_def, constrains it only when FLOOKUP tmsig name = SOME ty0 and ty = TYPE_SUBST tyin ty0. Outside that case (undeclared constant, or ty not an instance of the declared type) the value is open. The Lean definition adds a concrete else-branch, `fun _ => tmaof i name []`. So Lean proves, e.g., instance_ FEMPTY i name ty τ = tmaof i name [], and hence termsem mem FEMPTY i v (Const name ty) = tmaof i name []. HOL4 proves neither.
findings.repair:
theorem instance_exists : ∃ f : tmsig → interpretation U → mlstring → type → tyval U → U,
    ∀ (tmsig : tmsig) (i : interpretation U) (name : mlstring) (ty ty0 : type) (tyin : List (type × type)),
      FLOOKUP tmsig name = some ty0 ∧ ty = TYPE_SUBST tyin ty0 →
      f tmsig i name ty = fun τ => tmaof i name
        (MAP (typesem (tyaof i) τ ∘ TYPE_SUBST tyin ∘ Tyvar)
          (MAP .implode (STRING_SORT (MAP explode (tyvars ty0))))) := by sorry

def instance_ : tmsig → interpretation U → mlstring → type → tyval U → U :=
  Classical.choose (instance_exists (U := U))

theorem instance_def : ∀ (tmsig : tmsig) (i : interpretation U) (name : mlstring) (ty ty0 : type) (tyin : List (type × type)),
      FLOOKUP tmsig name = some ty0 ∧ ty = TYPE_SUBST tyin ty0 →
      instance_ tmsig i name ty = fun τ => tmaof i name
        (MAP (typesem (tyaof i) τ ∘ TYPE_SUBST tyin ∘ Tyvar)
          (MAP .implode (STRING_SORT (MAP explode (tyvars ty0))))) :=
  Classical.choose_spec (instance_exists (U := U))
findings.lean_check:
import CandleLean.HolSemantics
open HOL Candle.Mlstring Candle.HolSyntax Candle.HolSemantics

example {U : Type} (i : interpretation U) (name : mlstring) (ty : type) (τ : tyval U) :
    instance_ (FEMPTY : tmsig) i name ty τ = tmaof i name [] := by
  have hn : ¬ ∃ ty0 tyin, FLOOKUP (FEMPTY : tmsig) name = some ty0 ∧ ty = TYPE_SUBST tyin ty0 := by
    rintro ⟨ty0, tyin, h, _⟩
    simp [FLOOKUP, FEMPTY] at h
  unfold instance_
  rw [dif_neg hn]
findings.hol4_check: ∃f. (∀tmsig (i:bool interpretation) name ty ty0 tyin. FLOOKUP tmsig name = SOME ty0 ∧ ty = TYPE_SUBST tyin ty0 ⇒ f tmsig i name ty = (λτ. SND i name (MAP (typesem (FST i) τ o TYPE_SUBST tyin o Tyvar) (MAP implode (STRING_SORT (MAP explode (tyvars ty0))))))) ∧ (∃tmsig i name ty. f tmsig i name ty ≠ (λτ. SND i name []))
